1_xp_economy_anti_gaming.mechanism: source-level reward idempotency + repeatability controls (no hidden daily cap)
controls: template-scoped idempotency key prevents repeated same-template quest XP
COMPLETED template cannot be re-assigned (409 on /assign)
negative / NaN / non-finite XP and attribute deltas dropped
client cannot award XP directly (no award endpoint; progression routes read-only)
concurrent award race resolved via unique-constraint catch (23505) → alreadyAwarded
1_xp_economy_anti_gaming.daily_cap: NOT implemented — not justified by product rules (self-tracking product, sqrt level curve already bounds visible rank); source-level idempotency preferred per scope decision

2_completion_rate_limiting.response: 429 { message: 'Too many requests — please slow down' }
2_completion_rate_limiting.justification: authenticated-user identity primary limiter key; burst 120/10min does not interfere with normal gameplay

3_explainability_consistency.root_cause: WEAK_AREA reason driven only by single weakestAttribute/scoring factor while detectWeaknesses reports a multi-area set
3_explainability_consistency.fix: reasonCodes() emits WEAK_AREA for factor.weakness >= 0.7 OR weakAreas.has(category); weakAreas computed from detectWeaknesses(state) in both recommendTasks and recommendQuests

4_goal_lifecycle.model: single free-text ai_user_goals row per user (upsert on unique userId); no per-goal state machine; latest write wins; validation string length >= 5
4_goal_lifecycle.findings: IDOR safe (user B cannot read/overwrite user A); concurrent updates atomic; decomposition deterministic

invariants: concurrent mutations atomic; failed transaction leaves no partial award
user A cannot mutate user B

6_determinism.note: engine outputs byte-identical for identical state; legitimate time-dependence (daily-plan date, rotation) isolated to single JS clock

invariants: totalXp monotonic and === sum(xpEvents.amount) (no hidden minting)
goal switch aligns recommendations within 3-day window
repeated failure keeps difficulty ladder stable

8_performance.findings: no demonstrated N+1 or quadratic behavior; analytics layer uses fixed 8+1 parallel queries

coverage: malformed progress values (rejected/clamped, no 500, no overflow, no XP)
quest IDOR (user B cannot mutate user A)

facts: no deterministic engine module imports groq-sdk

11_browser_e2e.infrastructure: real Chromium 149.0.7827.0 (@sparticuz/chromium@149.0.0, npm-distributed binary) + puppeteer-core 25.9.0, headless shell, NSS/AL2023 shared libraries supplied via LD_LIBRARY_PATH
11_browser_e2e.app_stack: API server (esbuild dist) on :8080 against real PostgreSQL 18.4; static web build (vite) served via same-origin proxy on :9000 (/api forwarded)
11_browser_e2e.evidence: dashboard rendered real engine output — level '1', rank 'Initiate', '0 / 1,000 XP to next level', 'Total earned: 0 XP', 'DAILY PROGRESS', 'TODAY'S TASKS' (e.g. 'Do 3 sets of 10 push-ups'), 'ATTRIBUTES', 'TODAY'S TIP'
11_browser_e2e.notes: auth rate limiter (10/15min per IP) was independently observed returning 429 during repeated runs — confirmed functional; single clean run of both viewports uses 6 auth requests, under the limit

findings.title: Unbounded XP farming via repeatable quest completion
findings.reproduce: assign→complete→assign→complete the same ACTIVE template repeatedly awarded XP per instance (new questId each time)
findings.root_cause: idempotency was per quest instance (questId), not per (user, template); no guard against re-assigning an already-completed template
findings.fix: template-scoped idempotencyKey quest_complete_${userId}_${questTemplateId}; /assign returns 409 on COMPLETED template

findings.title: No rate limiting on quest/task completion endpoints
findings.reproduce: completion endpoints were unthrottled; a malicious client could flood mutations
findings.fix: makeMutationLimiter() mounted on assign/progress/abandon/complete + daily-task complete, keyed by authenticated user

findings.title: Concurrent awardXp race surfaced 500 (unique-constraint violation)
findings.reproduce: two concurrent awards with same idempotencyKey both passed inner re-check, second INSERT hit unique constraint → 500
findings.root_cause: READ COMMITTED allows both transactions to pass the SELECT re-check before either commits
findings.fix: catch 23505 on xp_transactions_idempotency_key_unique and return alreadyAwarded

findings.title: 532 weakness_vs_reason contradictions (weak-area recommendation without WEAK_AREA reason code)
findings.reproduce: recommendTasks surfaced ENDURANCE weak area but reasonCodes lacked WEAK_AREA
findings.root_cause: WEAK_AREA driven only by single scoring factor, not the multi-area detectWeaknesses set
findings.fix: emit WEAK_AREA for weakness>=0.7 OR weakAreas membership; compute weakAreas from detectWeaknesses in both recommendation paths

findings.title: Malformed/negative/NaN/huge XP and attribute deltas accepted into progression
findings.reproduce: awardXp with negative/NaN/huge values could pollute user_attributes and xp_transactions
findings.fix: sanitize: drop negative/NaN/non-finite; clamp oversized; PATCH progress path awards no XP

final_report.DEFECT_CLASSES: D x1 (concurrency), C x2 (explainability, sanitization), CLOSED x2 (AG-1 was C, AG-2 was B in Stage 19)
final_report.RECOMMENDED_NEXT_STEP: Ship. Non-blocking follow-ups: (1) add a per-day XP budget / template repeatability policy only if leaderboard/social competitive stakes ship; (2) optional unique index on ai_daily_tasks(user_id, date) to harden the cache-then-insert daily-task write
